tab_id.description: A tab id from TerminalList, such as term_3f9a

lines.description: How many lines from the end (default 200, at most 1000)

wait_for_output_ms.description: Wait up to this many milliseconds for new output before reading (at most 60000)

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
